**Finding: deviation (critical) — LOL-CAP**

Section 7 of the MSA is titled "Limitation of Liability" but contains only subsection (a): a mutual waiver of consequential/indirect/punitive damages, with indemnification and confidentiality breaches carved out of that waiver. There is no monetary cap:

- Searches for "exceed" and "aggregate liability" return nothing.
- No "Fees" defined term exists; Section 5 is a revenue-share where Kubient pays Customer, so there is no Customer-paid fee base at all.

Both parties' direct liability is therefore unlimited, which fails even the fallback (mutual cap of 12 months' fees). Note this is not one-sided in Vendor's favour, but the absence of any cap leaves AP fully exposed under its broad Section 10(b) indemnity for Content and Properties.

**Redline (validated, ok:true)** — new Section 7(b) inserted after p0027:

> Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability … shall not exceed the greater of (i) the aggregate amounts paid or payable under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (ii) USD 1,000,000. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights. Amounts due to a Party under Section 5 are not damages and are not subject to this limitation.

Two drafting adaptations to the model language: the cap base is "amounts paid or payable under this Agreement" rather than "fees paid by Customer" (a Customer-fee base would be illusory in a revenue-share), and Section 5 revenue-share payments owed to AP are expressly excluded from the cap so Kubient cannot use it to shrink amounts it owes us.
